title: Introduce lint-orbit presubmit orchestrator and gradual dependency-rollout job
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Adds a lightweight presubmit orchestrator (lint-orbit) to reduce noisy flakiness in lint shards and introduces a scheduled, staged dependency bump job with gradual rollout and automatic revert on regression signals.
description:
Context & motivation: Our presubmit lanes have grown noisy as language-specific lint plugins and toolchains diverge; transient failures and long cold-starts increase feedback latency for engineers. Separately, dependency upgrades are a major source of breakage when bumped en masse. This PR introduces two coordinated changes: 1) a lightweight presubmit orchestrator (lint-orbit) that directs PRs to an adaptive lint path based on changed files and historical flakiness, and 2) a scheduled 'gradual-dep-rollout' job that bumps non-breaking dependencies in small cohorts, runs targeted smoke/e2e checks, and gates promotion based on telemetry.

Summary of changes: - New service: ci/orchestrator/lint_orbit.go (Go) implements a file-pattern router and shard-weight adjustments based on recent flakiness scores stored in CI metadata. - Presubmit manifest changes: .ci/presubmit-profiles.yaml adds a 'lint-orbit' profile and lightweight runtime image references. - GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/presubmit-orbit.yml (composite action) wraps the new presubmit routing and fast-paths for small PRs. - Scheduled pipeline: .github/workflows/gradual-dep-rollout.yml configures cohorted npm/pip bump runs with rollback hooks. - Tooling: tooling/dep-bumper/README.md and tooling/dep-bumper/main.py implement the cohort selection, bump strategy (minor/patch-only by default), and telemetry export. - Tests: ci/test/ci_orchestrator_test.go and small shell harness scripts that emulate cohort selection and revert flows. - Docs: docs/ci/lint-orbit.md and docs/ci/dep-rollout.md describing operator controls, linear links, and runbooks.

Commits (high-level): ["0e43b9a - scaffold lint-orbit router and manifest + unit tests","7a1c4d1 - add presubmit-orbit composite action and fastpath rules","b5c8d2f - implement gradual-dep-rollout scheduler (GitHub workflow)","3f2d9aa - dep-bumper cohort selection, bump strategies, telemetry export","aa12f44 - doc + runbook for rollback and paging triggers","d3b6e90 - integration test harness and flakiness scoring shim"]

Files changed (high level): ["ci/orchestrator/lint_orbit.go", ".ci/presubmit-profiles.yaml", ".github/workflows/presubmit-orbit.yml", ".github/workflows/gradual-dep-rollout.yml", "tooling/dep-bumper/main.py", "tooling/dep-bumper/pyproject.toml", "ci/test/ci_orchestrator_test.go", "docs/ci/lint-orbit.md", "docs/ci/dep-rollout.md", "scripts/dep-rollout-smoke.sh", "Makefile (small target additions)"]

How lint-orbit works (summary): The orchestrator inspects the PR diff and consults a small presubmit index to pick one of three lanes: fastlight (tiny PRs, only changed files linted), orbit (normal), and shadow (for high-risk areas with known flakiness). Flakiness scores are derived from the last 30 days of CI metadata and are used to increase sampling for flaky shards rather than running the full shard matrix. The composite action provides a hermetic runtime image with preinstalled linters (which reduces image pull variability). This reduces mean presubmit latency for small PRs and lowers load on heavyweight integration runners.

How gradual-dep-rollout works (summary): A scheduled workflow picks a small cohort of modules (configurable window: 5-10 packages per run) and attempts minor/patch bumps. Each cohort run triggers a targeted test matrix: unit tests for changed modules, a small set of smoke integration routes, and a gated round of selected presubmit linters. If telemetry (build pass rate, test flakiness, runtime regression signals from perf-canary) crosses thresholds, the workflow triggers an automatic revert PR and notifies the on-call via PagerDuty runbook produced in docs/ci/dep-rollout.md.

Testing & validation: Unit tests added for the routing logic; a local integration harness that runs workflow steps in docker for devs; staged rollout tested internally using a 'dry-run' mode that exercises cohort selection without committing bumps. We also ran a week-long shadow mode (lint-orbit ran in parallel without blocking merges) to validate risk thresholds. Observability: new metrics exported to prometheus: ci_presubmit_latency_seconds{lane=\"fastlight|orbit|shadow\"}, dep_rollout_cohort_size, dep_rollout_reverts_total. Dashboards preconfigured in observability-pack under ci/lint-orbit.

Reviewer conversation (high-level): - Evan Li: "Nice reduction in noise — can we make the flakiness window configurable per-repo?" Reply: "Yes; added .ci/presubmit-profiles.yaml override with repo-level window (default 30 days)." - María Ortiz: "Concern about automatic revert PR spam if thresholds are aggressive." Reply: "We added a two-step revert: first creates a 'dep-revert' draft PR and posts a Slack thread to #release-ops for 30 minutes before auto-merge; this is configurable in workflow inputs." - Samir Patel: "Can we ensure secret scoping for dep-bumper tokens?" Reply: "dep-bumper uses a scoped machine user token stored as secrets.DEP_BUMPER_TOKEN and is limited by repo write scope; doc updated."

CI summary & flaky handling: Initial CI run on this PR showed one flaky lint shard failure on node-tooling; we introduced a retry-with-delay wrapper in the composite action and re-ran — all checks passed. CI checks: unit tests (go/python) passed, composite action image build passed, e2e smoke matrix passed in shadow mode. ci_status set to pass.

Rollout plan & operator controls: - Phase 1: Merge in shadow mode for 48 hours (lint-orbit runs but does not block merges). - Phase 2: Enable fastlight fast-path for PRs under 10 changed files. - Phase 3: Enable gradual-dep-rollout scheduled runs on Tuesday 0200 UTC with cohort size 5. - Operator knobs exposed: .ci/presubmit-profiles.yaml (shard thresholds, flakiness window), workflow inputs for cohort size and revert delay, and a feature flag in config/ci_flags.yaml to disable auto-reverts.

Backout & incident notes: If the dep rollout causes regressions at scale, the workflow will open a draft revert PR and page the on-call. A manual rollback playbook is in docs/ci/dep-rollout.md with commands to pin the affected package versions and disable the scheduled workflow.

Security & compliance: dep-bumper enforces checksum verification (pip hash and npm integrity) and uses read-only registries where possible. We added a lightweight SAR check to ensure no PR bumps cross our allowed dependency allowlist.

Why this is unique: Rather than one-off presubmit tuning or a single bulk dep-bump, this change combines an adaptive presubmit routing model with a staged, telemetry-driven dependency upgrade pipeline that emphasizes safety, observability, and low engineer friction.

Follow-ups: (1) Integrate dep-rollout telemetry into the release-cost dashboard (ENG-2190). (2) Expand lint-orbit's ML-based flakiness predictor as a follow-up research spike (ENG-2233).
